Wednesday Evening Series #3 – Big Finn Hill
Wednesday Evening Series #4 – Seattle Pacific University
Thank You All Volunteers!

The fifth and final event in this year’s Wednesday Evening Series! The Wednesday Evening Series is our most relaxed, casual set of navigation events, held in local parks once the weather warms up. These events are a little more low-key than those in the WIOL/Winter Series, and we always offer a barbeque afterward for all participants. Decompress after work, with or without your coworkers. Or meet your family at the park and enjoy a night off from cooking. Or meet a bunch of friends at the park for an evening of exploring together, chatting over some food, and finishing up with frisbee on the lawn.
Events in the Wednesday Evening Series are generally less challenging (both physically and navigationally) than many of our other events, and are therefore great for beginners and those less experienced with orienteering – while also offering a challenge to longtime participants of the sport.
Check back later for special notes from the Course Designer(s). The layout of Carkeek Park is defined by a ravine system running down to Puget Sound; as such, the park is fairly steep, and thickly forested for the most part – but also offers a public beach and great views of the Sound! This is a “trails-only” venue – the forest is generally mapped as olive green, which denotes areas that are out-of-bounds. Please stay on trails so that we may continue to enjoy access to Carkeek Park in the future!
You can view the orienteering map of Carkeek Park here: http://rg.cascadeoc.org/rg2/#156
